    <h1>The hydrogen atom</h1>
    <p class="course-toc-meta">Topic: Bound states and spectra</p>
  </header>

::: {.qft-exam-body}
1.  Compute the wave functions of the hydrogen atom for $n=1$, $j=1/2$. Plot them. Compare them with the solution of the Schrödinger equation for $n=1$.

2.  Compute and plot the emission spectrum of the hydrogen atom in Dirac's theory.

3.  The energy levels of a hydrogen atom change in the gravitational field of a star. For the photons emitted by the atoms this leads to the gravitational redshift $$z= \frac{\Delta\nu}{\nu}=\frac{GM}{Rc^2},$$ where $G$ is the gravitational constant and $M$ and $R$ are the mass and the radius of the star. Compute $\Delta\nu/\nu$ for different types of stars. Which of them allow one to observe the *gravitational* redshift? Compare with experiment.

:::
